full_judgment: 5. On consideration of the evidence, both oral and documentary, particularly Exhibits I and 2 (sale certificate and certificate relating to delivery of possession respectively) trial Court decreed the suit. The Court of first instance disbelieved Exhibit Uma, (information slip) on the face of Exhibits 1 and 2 and that also observed that entry of name of Sukadha Sundari in the R.S. Khatian was probable since the same was prepared prior to the auction sale and that SA Khatian having been prepared in the light of the RS Khatian the name of Sukadha Sundari was entered therein. The court of first instance found possession in favour of the plaintiffs.
